title: Don't Surf Alone. Find Your Surf Buddy.

cast.name: Ella
cast.appearance: fictional adult British woman, age 25, chestnut brown shoulder-length wavy hair loosely tied back, natural freckles, hazel eyes, muted ocean-teal long-sleeve surf rash vest and dark navy knee-length board shorts, plain off-white longboard with a narrow teal rail

cast.name: Nia
cast.appearance: fictional adult woman, age 26, medium brown skin, dark curly hair in a relaxed low ponytail, warm dark eyes, muted terracotta long-sleeve surf rash vest and charcoal knee-length board shorts, plain pale yellow longboard

continuity: Weligama Beach, Sri Lanka; broad sandy horseshoe bay, small gentle beginner surf, tropical palms in the distance, soft warm morning light, modest realistic surf conditions. Both women are adults on a relaxed holiday. Preserve faces, clothing, board colours and light direction. No visible brand names on boards or clothes.

dialogues.speaker: ella
dialogues.text: Hey! Love surfing but don't have anyone to surf with? You don't need to surf alone!

dialogues.speaker: ella
dialogues.text: With Tips to Trip, use Meet Buddy to find travellers nearby who share your interests.

dialogues.speaker: ella
dialogues.text: Just open Meet Buddy, update your Travel Status, and tell other travellers what you're planning. Save it, and let them find you. It's that simple!

dialogues.speaker: ella
dialogues.text: And look! Another traveller nearby is interested in joining.

dialogues.speaker: ella
dialogues.text: Hey! You must be the one who replied!

dialogues.speaker: nia
dialogues.text: Yes! Ready to catch some waves?

dialogues.speaker: ella
dialogues.text: Don't miss out on amazing experiences just because you're travelling alone. Find your people with Tips to Trip Meet Buddy!

surfStatus: Looking for a Surf Buddy! Hey travellers! I'm in Weligama and planning to go surfing today. Anyone around here interested in joining me for a surf session? Let's connect and enjoy the waves together!
responseNote: Hey! I'm also in Weligama. I'd love to join you for surfing!

productionPolicy.story: Fictional dramatisation of the supplied real-life scenario; never presented as a verified customer testimonial.
productionPolicy.app: Actual supplied app recordings and native controls. User-requested fictional surf status, names, avatars and request note are documented demonstration edits.
productionPolicy.request: A sent request remains awaiting a response. Transition to the beach meeting is a story time jump, not fabricated evidence of backend acceptance.
productionPolicy.lipSync: Generate native Higgsfield spoken performances first. Review mouth motion and intelligibility before any final ElevenLabs voice conversion. Preserve original video timing; compare converted word timing and audio envelopes. Final visible performance must be reviewed again.
productionPolicy.timing: 60 seconds gives the greeting and complete closing voiceover room after the user's 41-second app/story setup. App introduction shortened for natural delivery; post terminology mapped to the native Travel Status feature.

voiceCasting.ella: Alice: clear conversational British English; new performance for Ella.
voiceCasting.nia: Lily: distinct confident British English; new performance for Nia.
